patthana16.33:1.1: dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbahetuko na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā soḷasa.
patthana16.33:2.1: dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā nava.
